result.markdown:
# Call setup failures and dropped calls in Grand Tunis

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-TUN-005`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence from configuration changes, KPI onset timing, minor alarms, and recovery upon rollback. External events: not checked (no tool call made).)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-10 10:00 to 2026-09-10 19:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-10 10:01
- **Affected:** S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, S-TUN-013

## Summary

Parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4 applied to sites S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-013 at 2026-09-10 10:01 caused RRC success drops and drop rate spikes.

RRC success rate dropped and drop rates spiked across three sites in Grand Tunis starting 2026-09-10 10:00 and recovering at 19:30.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-10 10:00: RRC success drops and drop rate spikes began on S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-013. [T1, T4]
- 2026-09-10 10:01: Configuration changes CHG-2026-0021, CHG-2026-0022, and CHG-2026-0023 applied. [CHG-2026-0021, CHG-2026-0022, CHG-2026-0023]
- 2026-09-10 10:42: Minor RRC failure rate high alarm raised on S-TUN-012. [ALM-000190]
- 2026-09-10 19:26: Rollback changes applied to revert parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4. [T3, T7]
- 2026-09-10 19:27: Minor alarm cleared on S-TUN-012. [ALM-000190]
- 2026-09-10 19:30: Alert ALR-0010 ended after 9.5 hours of impact. [ALR-0010]

## Evidence

- RRC success dropped and drop rates spiked on S-TUN-005, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-013 from 2026-09-10 10:00. [T1, T4]
- Scheduled parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4 was applied to all three affected sites at 2026-09-10 10:01. [CHG-2026-0021, CHG-2026-0022, CHG-2026-0023]
- PRB utilization showed no deviation across the affected sites. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites and their parents between 2026-09-10 09:00 and 13:00. [T5]
- All three affected sites recovered when the configuration changes were rolled back in the evening. [T1, T3, T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-TUN-005: confirmed. Configuration changes applied precisely at KPI onset and reverted at recovery match the incident timeline. [CHG-2026-0021, CHG-2026-0022, CHG-2026-0023, T1, T4]
2. **capacity** at S-TUN-005: rejected. PRB utilization showed no deviation during the incident window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T5: No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes during the window.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4 before future deployments.
- Verify post-change monitoring alerts trigger faster.

- `CHG-2026-0023`: config_push on S-TUN-013 at 2026-09-10 10:01: Scheduled parameter optimisation batch RT-2.4 applied to S-TUN-013 [ROLLED BACK by CHG-2026-0027 at 2026-09-10 19:26]

truth.notes: trap=bad_change_loud_coincidence; A scheduled parameter optimisation batch pushed to the 3 sites of LNK-TUN-01-C regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back. Root cause node is the first site of the pushed group. Trap: a major alarm on LNK-TUN-01-C, the parent of the pushed sites, flaps around the onset and clears by itself, and the change record looks innocent. Settled by: (1) the alarm clears within minutes while the KPI regression goes on for hours, and availability stays at 100 %; (2) the regression starts at the change time on exactly the pushed sites and ends at the rollback; (3) the sites of the sibling links are normal.
